item.title: Demystifying Machine Learning Explainability: From Black Box to Glass Box
item.description: This article explores the importance of machine learning explainability and interpretability in modern data science. Learn about SHAP values, LIME, feature importance techniques, and how to make your ML models more transparent and trustworthy for stakeholders and regulatory compliance.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: The Role of Stochastic Processes in Data Science Innovation
item.description: This article delves into the sophisticated application of stochastic processes within data science. Readers will gain an advanced understanding of how randomness is modeled and utilized to enhance predictions and decision-making in complex, uncertain environments. From machine learning algorithms to financial market modeling, stochastic processes are pivotal in driving innovation and extracting meaningful insights from data.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: OLAP Cubes and Multidimensional Modeling with SQL Server Analysis Services.
item.description: In this article, you will learn about OLAP cubes and multidimensional modeling with SQL Server Analysis Services. This is a key concept for data analysts to understand, as it is a common way to store and analyze data in a data warehouse.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: Two Sample Proportion Tests | Comparing Population Proportions
item.description: The article delves into the world of two-sample proportion tests, offering insights into comparing proportions between distinct populations. It explores both manual calculation and a more streamlined approach using Python's statsmodels library. From understanding the theoretical foundation of two-sample proportion tests to implementing them practically, readers gain a comprehensive understanding of how to assess significant differences in proportions within categorical data.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: Stock Price Prediction with Apache Spark and Apache Cassandra.
item.description: This blog aims to show you how to predict stock prices using machine learning techniques, Apache Spark, and Apache Cassandra. The goal is to build a data pipeline that collects stock data, preprocesses it, engineers features, and trains a machine learning model to predict future prices.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: Building a Chatbot for your E-commerce Business using Django
item.description: This article provides a comprehensive guide on how to build a chatbot for an e-commerce business using the Django framework, including the creation of models, views, templates and integration with the e-commerce platform.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: Data-Engineering-Technologies
item.description: Data engineering is a crucial field that enables organizations to derive value from their data. It involves the design, construction, and maintenance of systems for collecting, storing, and processing data, with the aim of making it available for use in business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning.

item.title: Calculating Measures of Spread Using Python
item.description: In this article, I'll talk about a set of summary statistics; measures of spread.Spread is just what it sounds like - it describes how spread apart or close together the data points are. Just like measures of centre, there are a few different measures of spread.
